positions.statement: On his campaign homepage, Savas says he is guiding a strong economic recovery and the construction of affordable housing so county families can thrive.
positions.excerpt: guiding a strong economic recovery and the construction of affordable housing so Clackamas County families can thrive

positions.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Savas says the county has encouraged new or expanding businesses that provide higher-than-average salaries to expand in Clackamas County.
positions.excerpt: Another strategy of ours has been to encourage new or expanding businesses that provide “higher than average salaries” to expand in Clackamas county.

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Savas lists keeping seniors safe in their homes by supporting property tax deferral.
positions.excerpt: Keeping seniors safe in their homes by supporting property tax deferral.

positions.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Savas says the county has a record of building affordable housing but lacks the resources to build its way out of the homeless crisis.
positions.excerpt: Clackamas County has a long history and good track record of building affordable housing and we know this helped address homelessness however there are not enough resources to build our way out of the homeless crisis.

positions.statement: In a September 2023 county news release, Savas is quoted saying Clackamas County is working hard to increase access to addiction treatment and recovery services.
positions.excerpt: Clackamas County is working hard to increase access to addiction treatment and recovery services,” stated Clackamas County Commissioner Paul Savas.

positions.statement: His county commissioner page lists, among his priorities, maintaining strong stewardship of natural resources and supporting engaged communities.
positions.excerpt: Maintaining strong stewardship of our natural resources, and supporting engaged communities

positions.statement: His county commissioner page lists, among his priorities, fiscal decision-making that ensures future stability and protects investments in infrastructure.
positions.excerpt: Promote fiscal responsibility with decision-making that ensures future stability, protects investments in infrastructure

positions.statement: OPB reported in August 2026 that Savas, discussing a possible data center moratorium, said he is more anxious to act than to wait for an application the county is not prepared for.
positions.excerpt: I'm more anxious to do something rather than sit back and get an application that we're not prepared for,” Savas said.

positions.statement: A June 2015 KOIN report (from the Portland Tribune) quotes Savas saying a state building moratorium over wastewater treatment capacity is a risk but there is time to avoid it.
positions.excerpt: That's a risk, but we have time to avoid it

positions.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Savas says the independently elected sheriff's office currently responds to judicial warrants and follows evolving federal and state law.
positions.excerpt: the Sheriffs office’s practice currently is to respond to judicial warrants and follow the ever evolving interpretation of federal and state law.

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Savas says he and colleagues fought for fair access to parks, natural areas, libraries, and services for veterans and seniors.
positions.excerpt: we fought for fair access to parks, natural areas, libraries, and services for veterans and seniors.

voting_record.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Savas says he voted with the Board of Commissioners a few years ago to reduce the county's vehicle registration fee.
voting_record.excerpt: A few years ago I voted with the Board of Commissioners to reduce the county’s vehicle registration fee.
